target: Fixed-address event-observed workload and pipeline notification coverage under declared source evidence; not complete historical protocol population.

changes_to_prior_gates.prior_requirement: Complete historical routing/upgrade/owner/writer continuity for dynamic entrypoint population
changes_to_prior_gates.new_requirement: Fixed finite address nomination from historical primary core-role metadata; continuity is not required for generic address/event-shape statistics.

changes_to_prior_gates.prior_requirement: Source/runtime equivalence as a universal population prerequisite
changes_to_prior_gates.new_requirement: Required only where a claim consumes those semantics; generic event-shape measurement requires exact decoder/method source and historical chain/address/core-role provenance. Existing exact bindings remain evidence.

changes_to_prior_gates.prior_requirement: Observable mechanism as possible eligibility wording
changes_to_prior_gates.new_requirement: No eligible positive reference is removed because the fixed stream has no core log, no positive core outflow, cold start, no trigger or no emitted notification.

preserved_commitments.window_rule: [D-29 days 00:00 UTC,D+1 day 00:00 UTC), with actual verified execution date D and exact boundaries frozen before measurement. Do not shorten for unavailable data, deployment timing, zero flow or cold start.
preserved_commitments.selection_rule: Complete the same bounded nomination/source-readiness disposition for all original rows, then apply the retained first-eligible-per-verified-family fixed order, filling remaining slots in that order. Async completion never changes order.

address_nomination.role_predicate: Documented canonical public user entrypoint or core custody/vault contract for the named historical component/version/chain. Enumerate all qualifying records in the chosen finite manifest or the full explicitly coequal canonical entrypoint set.
address_nomination.historical_identity_sufficiency: A usable historical primary manifest or canonical documented entrypoint supporting chain/address and core role is sufficient for this fixed workload; no universal exhaustive source/writer search. Record deployment/existence bounds and uncertainty without asserting continuous identity.
address_nomination.ambiguity_rule: Materially ambiguous components, versions or equally supported sets remain PENDING until metadata adjudication; never choose by signal, download success or detector outcome.
address_nomination.artifact_completeness_claim: Only within the named finite artifact; never all protocol-owned contracts without independent roster closure.
address_nomination.implementation_rule: No automatic inclusion of facets, implementation libraries, external token emitters, owner EOAs or counterparties. A separately documented qualifying direct role is required.
address_nomination.incident_informed_route: Allowed only with explicit retrospective nomination exposure; ownership/deployment confirmation does not make nomination incident-independent.
address_nomination.previous_lifi_revest_targets: Retain as exposed discovery evidence; re-evaluate under the uniform rule, never automatic admission.
address_nomination.chain_rule: Retain every primary-supported affected chain in the row; freeze chain-specific populations and budget accounting before payloads. No availability-driven silent choice of one chain.

observation_contract.selected_transactions: S = transactions within the fixed case-chain window with at least one accepted source log emitted by an address in A.
observation_contract.bundle_scope: All emitted logs and verified actual execution status for each selected transaction; same complete bundle available to every comparison arm before decision.
observation_contract.count_input: Core-emitter subset count for each selected transaction.
observation_contract.semantic_external_out: ERC20-shaped event with Transfer.from in A and nonzero Transfer.to outside A, aggregated per token emitter in raw integer units.
observation_contract.proof_tier: Declare actual source tier; terminal pagination or complete enumerated archive is not receipt-root or full-chain cryptographic authentication.
observation_contract.empty_day_rule: An exhaustively enumerated empty day is valid. Missing/partial data is UNAVAILABLE and cannot be converted to zero. Preserve the full window.
observation_contract.predeployment_rule: Retain fixed-window observations; call a period predeployment only when structurally supported. Uncertain deployment time does not manufacture a zero period.

method_commitments.rules_and_thresholds: Unchanged Phase8 count/semantic contracts and fixed config parameters; no retuning based on case mechanisms or outcomes.
method_commitments.initialization_limit: Continuous feature carry-over requires a separate explicit prospective amendment; it is not an unchanged Phase8 replay.
method_commitments.driver_adaptation: A new source-bound driver may replace Euler-specific plumbing while preserving method behavior and input equality; old drivers/results remain immutable.
method_commitments.labels: No labels in input selection, history, scores, grouping or budget decisions. Freeze positive-inventory/adjudication and attribution procedures; seal decisions before joining.
method_commitments.independence_claim: Only relative to frozen affected methods and disclosed design/exposure; never global unseen status or incident-independent nomination by implication.

pipeline_denominators.outer_reference: All independently verified applicable reference incidents and their verified execution transactions; report the two units separately.
pipeline_denominators.missing_evidence: UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN, never a measured miss or exclusion; preserve its outer reference status and report undefined/bounded coverage separately.
pipeline_denominators.known_execution_notification_coverage: Notified verified reference executions / all verified reference executions, including observed unselected and cold-start executions; only report a fully observed numerical rate where required observation evidence is complete.
pipeline_denominators.conditional_rates: May be additional descriptors with named denominators; never replace the outer reference denominator.
pipeline_denominators.incident_miss_requirement: Complete independent incident execution inventory and complete applicable observation evidence. No hit among an incomplete known hash subset proves only known-execution noncoverage.
pipeline_denominators.input_expansion: Never add labeled but unselected transactions to detector inputs. Coverage audits are separate post-decision records.
pipeline_denominators.unknown_alerts: Remain UNKNOWN without adjudication; not false positives or measured precision.

root_acceptance_stanza.authority: Existing continuing user authorization; root records scientific design acceptance without requesting user permission again.
